plan: Reproduce the supplied combined/extended-only comparison for local image files and folders, recording modern versus classic entries separately for all three utilities.

steps: 1. Select the image file. In combined default/extended mode, capture modern right-click and Show more options menus; count each affected command and identify its provider.

3. Repeat after a supported Store update/repair in the disposable account. Compare package and classic-handler registrations and note whether duplicates return.
4. Disable and re-enable each tool and rerun the same matrix. Correlate proven failures with the existing tool-specific trackers; keep uncovered rows on this issue.
